$comment: Glyph Protocol `glyf` payloads for every private-use icon the TUI emits, extracted from JetBrainsMono NFM Regular (Version 2.304; Nerd Fonts 3.5.1): simple glyphs only, hinting stripped, outlines lifted by +300 so y=0 is the descender line of the aw×lh layout box. Powerline glyphs carry stretch=true. Generated offline; regenerate from the same font when icons are added.
